desc: The CVA Endura Series is the next generation of muzzleloading performance, purpose built for hunters who demand long-range accuracy, modern design and versatility in the field. The Endura LRH is CVA's first muzzleloader rated for use with either Blackhorn 209 or specifically recommended modern smokeless rifle powders. Each Endura model is built around a Bergara barrel threaded for CVA muzzle brake specifically designed for these high-performance loads and employs the advanced Variflame ignition system, a magnetic bolt face for easy priming and our corrosion-resistant tungsten lined breech plug. Includes PowerBelt .45-285 ELR Bullets, R=reinforced Carbon-Fiber collapsible ramrod, fixed one piece ramrod and Endura accessory kit.
